These are single slash-containing file-shaped tokens ending in .ts under the decided repair definition; the embedded plus, dollar or Unicode letter is not trailing sentence punctuation, a bracket or a quote. The lexer discards the authoritative root/path prefix before terminal anchoring can operate. The same class can silently drop an unsupported-character missing filename next to another valid citation. Authority: repair bead .5's any-slash-token/whole-token/trim-only rules, owning bead AC2 and G-finding-evidence's observes. Current committed registry pointers resolve; the material consequence is false admission of a future mistyped or missing evidence identity, not missing current evidence. Owner: citation extraction/admission in this PR. Closure: preserve the complete file-shaped identity across legal filename characters, or fail unsupported whole identities explicitly; never resolve a surviving fragment as another citation. Permanent evidence: extend the generalized identity invariant across token characters as well as extensions, compound suffixes, anchors, missing targets and collisions; that is proportionate to this checker and requires no corpus census. Required next state: repair before approval. This citation-identity class has survived two repair cycles; under the review policy, another narrow dispatch on the class is not permitted. A fresh full review of the affected candidate-gate subsystem is required.

Owner: JSON-to-file execution admission. Consequence is bounded: current root config has one project, and the actual failed run makes G-suite FAIL, so this does not produce an overall passing bundle. Closure: aggregate assertion outcomes by normalized file identity before admission, with any failed assertion excluding that identity. Permanent evidence: one generalized duplicate-file/status aggregation invariant varying record order, rather than separate project-specific permanent reproducers. Primary S2 is repaired for the current producer, including wholly skipped/filtered files; this is a remaining lower-consequence sibling. Required next state: repair this accepted finding in the current PR and review the affected mechanism.

Owner: CLI command capture. This is a false-red usability regression, not an overall false green. Closure: preserve argument boundaries when invoking npm/Vitest (an argument vector or correct platform-appropriate quoting). Permanent evidence: proportionate invocation coverage that demonstrates a whitespace-containing output path reaches the JSON reporter intact. Required next state: repair in this PR.
